claims.claim: Ordinary pytest policy references the existing Human-selected 12/load/max_worker_restart=0 profile without introducing another worker selector.
V2 candidate, base, affected, exact reproduction and correction invocations supply explicit fixed xdist arguments while preserving authored command coverage and binding effective commands separately.
The repository-configured pytest plugin defaults ordinary execution to 12 workers, preserves explicit fixed diagnostic counts, and assigns collection-only operations zero workers.
Observations record actual worker configuration, argv and toolchain conditions; profile and reuse gates reject stale 1-worker/4-worker proof as fresh 12-worker evidence.

Worker validation requires collection agreement, distinct process and mutable-root identities, matching profiles and toolchains, valid raw status and bounded complete observations. Invalid observations stop before base replay or broader fallback.

Targeted regressions cover default execution, collection-only, historical profiles, unsupported commands, stale proof and malformed worker conditions using injected execution facts without nested suite executions.
Changes remain within authorized paths and retain the selected full-suite launcher, immutable historical measurement context, minimum-sufficient-v2 authority and TASK-342 implementation files.
